About Us

Shah Jahan Memorial Clinic

Compassionate Care. Personalized Attention.

Shah Jahan Memorial Clinic provides professional homeopathic consultation in a welcoming and patient-centered environment. We focus on understanding each patient's individual concerns and providing personalized care with compassion, attention, and respect.

Your well-being is our priority.

Frequently Asked Questions
Quick answers for new patients.




Walk-ins are welcome during clinic hours, but booking an appointment above helps you get seen faster and lets us assign the right doctor.


We're open two shifts daily: 10 AM – 1 PM and 4 PM – 10 PM. Individual doctor timings may vary — check the Doctors section above.


Call or WhatsApp any doctor directly from their card, use the floating WhatsApp button, or send a Medical Enquiry from the Contact section.


Always inform your doctor about any other medication or treatment you're currently taking so they can guide you safely.
